contract_documents.document_text: A purchase order becomes binding upon the supplier’s written confirmation. Any purchase-order term that varies from this agreement applies only if the supplier expressly accepts that term in its written confirmation. A buyer cancellation right not stated in an accepted order requires a written amendment signed by both parties.

provisions.clause_text: A purchase order becomes binding upon the supplier’s written confirmation. A purchase-order term varying from this agreement applies only if expressly accepted in the supplier’s written confirmation.
The buyer may not cancel an accepted order for convenience unless the right is expressly accepted in the order confirmation or set out in a written amendment signed by both parties.

contract_documents.document_text: The buyer orders 18 packaging stations. Buyer-added term: Buyer may cancel this order without charge by giving the supplier 10 days’ written notice. This order is governed by Equipment Purchase Agreement EPA-31.

provisions.clause_text: Buyer may cancel this order without charge by giving the supplier 10 days’ written notice.

contract_documents.document_text: The supplier confirms the order for 18 packaging stations. The supplier does not accept the buyer-added cancellation term. Cancellation for convenience requires the supplier’s written consent; no cancellation without charge is agreed.

provisions.clause_text: We confirm the order for 18 packaging stations but do not accept the buyer-added cancellation term. Cancellation for convenience requires our written consent; cancellation without charge is not agreed.

assessment_rationale: The purchase order contains the claimed cancellation language, but the agreement makes differing order terms effective only when expressly accepted by the supplier. The supplier’s confirmation expressly rejects that term and instead requires written consent for cancellation for convenience. No bilateral amendment supplies the missing authorization, so the package does not support the claimed unilateral, no-charge right.

missing_critical_evidence.missing_document_or_clause: A written amendment signed by both parties granting the buyer a no-charge cancellation right on 10 days’ notice.
missing_critical_evidence.why_it_is_critical: The supplier’s confirmation rejects the purchase-order cancellation term, and the agreement requires a bilateral signed amendment for a cancellation right not accepted in the confirmation. No such amendment is present.
